div.p: Ashan is a world exhausted by war.
Centuries of conflict have reduced the peoples of Ashan... to four unruly nations.
The Demons, children of Urgash, the dragon of Chaos.
The Knights, clinging to old beliefs in the ruins of their empire.
The Wizards, wielders of magic and seekers of knowledge.
The Necromancers, offering deathless peace amidst the chaos.
I stand before you offering hope for a better future...
and praying that together we can bring it about.
In the wilderness you will found a city
build it up with troops and tradesmen,...
and lead forth its armies to unite the lands.
You will find both allies and enemies along the way.
Challenging enemies across the world... as your unstoppable armies unify the realms,...
...under your banners balance will be restored!
